sect1.title: Introduction
sect1.para: The structs module provides a collection of data structures that are used throughout the |g-framework| for storing and managing data.

sect1.title: The bsc_t Class
sect1.para: The bsc_t class is a base class for handling basic data types and their conversions.

listitem.para: data_enum root_type_translate(std::string* root_str): Translates a ROOT type string into a data_enum value.
std::string as_string(): Converts the current data type to a string representation.
void flush_buffer(): Flushes the data buffer.
bool element(...): A set of overloaded methods for accessing the data in the buffer.

sect1.title: The element_t Struct
sect1.para: The element_t struct represents a single entry in a ROOT tree, providing access to the data in the leaves.

listitem.para: void set_meta(): Sets the metadata for the event.
bool next(): Moves to the next event in the tree.
bool boundary(): Checks if the end of the tree has been reached.

sect1.title: The data_t Struct
sect1.para: The data_t struct is a data container for a single leaf in a ROOT tree.

listitem.para: void initialize(): Initializes the data container by opening the ROOT file and setting up the tree and leaf pointers.
bool next(): Moves to the next event in the tree.
void fetch_buffer(): Fetches the data from the ROOT file into the buffer.

sect1.title: The optimizer_params_t Struct
sect1.para: The optimizer_params_t struct holds the parameters for a PyTorch optimizer. It provides a set of properties for setting the various optimizer parameters, such as learning rate, weight decay, etc.

sect1.title: Other Structs
sect1.para:
The module also defines several other structs for data storage and management:
graph_hdf5_w, graph_hdf5: Structs for serializing and deserializing graph data to and from HDF5 files.
model_report: A struct for storing the report of a model's training progress.
folds_t: A struct for storing k-fold information.
write_t, writer: Classes for writing data to ROOT files.
variable_t: A class for handling variables of different types.
